Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-11-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-01.gif]], 1 June 2022) → [[File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-11-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V4-L-jakkuniimaoutpostshipyard-2022-06-11.png]], 11 June 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 2 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
